source_backed_hot_paths.fact: read_ref reads entire JSON bytes and SHA-hashes them, then api.read_json reopens/rereads/parses same file. Cache lookups in validate_context/validate_attempt/validate_completion occur after read_ref, so even validated references are reread before result reuse.
source_backed_hot_paths.inference: Direct source match to observed readall+one-shot SHA combination; number/size of runtime repeats not measured.

source_backed_hot_paths.fact: validate_files rehashes every historical snapshot member using sha(path.read_bytes()). Every historical_checker calls it for context and completion; every HistoryView.resolve validates legacy files again. These bypass Checker.file_hash cache.
source_backed_hot_paths.inference: Likely major repeated whole-file work in this history-rich invocation, especially if preserved assets are large. No old archive content or inventory was read to quantify it.

source_backed_hot_paths.fact: canonical_hashes and execution_fingerprints use one-shot read_bytes/sha rather than Checker.file_hash. prepare_inventory calls canonical_hashes and section_bytes directly, bypassing instance section memoization.
source_backed_hot_paths.inference: Repeated inventory validation can reread/reparse unchanged inputs; counts not profiled.

source_backed_hot_paths.fact: validate_attempt validates context then creates two historical Checkers for original/current canonical views, each with fresh own caches; context itself calls checker.run.
source_backed_hot_paths.inference: Required distinct semantic checks multiply file IO and parsing; optimizing shared immutable IO is safer than deleting either view.

source_backed_hot_paths.fact: workflow_progress creates fresh Checker and normal child.run(projections=False); at most two probes. validate_ready_projection triggers this after outer validation. Fresh child caches do not share verified source IO with the outer invocation.
source_backed_hot_paths.inference: Projection validation repeats normal history/checker work even though recursive projection is prevented.

source_backed_hot_paths.fact: Checker.file_hash and section_cache already memoize within each Checker invocation and guard signatures/final immutability. Every distinct heading still rereads and scans full document once through section_bytes. run clears caches, and historical/progress child Checkers have separate caches.
source_backed_hot_paths.inference: Canonical document parsing contributes, but the measured interval does not justify a regex rewrite or prove regex backtracking.

safe_bounded_future_options.proposal: Share a bounded per-top-level-invocation stable physical-file hash/JSON-byte cache across historical and progress child checkers. Preserve each child semantic validation; reuse only verified immutable IO.
required_invariants: Key by real physical path and full dev/ino/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns identity; logical overlay path alone is insufficient.
Use existing no-link/reparse/stable-open safeguards, verify signature before/after retrieval and at top-level invocation end.
No cross-CLI persistent trust and no acceptance-result caching without complete source/context binding.
Mutation, replacement, symlink, history-reference hash conflict or oversize metadata remains blocked.

safe_bounded_future_options.proposal: Hash historical large regular snapshot files with stable streaming hash_file rather than read_bytes into a one-shot SHA. Thread bounded verified hash cache through validate_files/read_ref/canonical_hashes/execution_fingerprints.
required_invariants: Do not skip any historical file, failed attempt, hash or provenance check.
Directory additions/removals must remain covered by exact inventory and directory signature checks.

safe_bounded_future_options.proposal: Parse/index each immutable Markdown document once per invocation and preserve exact unique-heading/fence/BOM/UTF8/ATX section byte semantics; cache section bytes/digests keyed to verified file identity.
required_invariants: Duplicate headings and invalid headings remain errors.
Retain all canonical JSON, traceability, ID boundary and source-fragment checks.
Use adversarial fence/duplicate-heading/mutation tests; do not rewrite regex based on this sample alone.

metadata_followup.recommended_smallest_future_scope: Replace repeated legacy validate_files whole-buffer hashing with one invocation-scoped shared stable hash memo (physical path+full file signature; original expected hash still compared eachtime; final signature audit), and stable streaminghash on firstread. Propagate memo through historical and progress Checkers; keep every legacy member and both semantic views. Profile/measure actual callcount afterward before broader canonical parser rewrite.

current_ownership.behavior: Own per-Checker hash_cache/json_cache/section_cache/directory_cache. Root run clears them; final invocation audit checks cached file and directory signatures.

historical_checker receives cache and assigns same _history_cache to nested historical Checkers. validate_context/attempt/completion memoize semantic results after read_ref. Outer normal Checker initializes _history_cache afresh. Legacy validate_files has no cache parameter and bypasses this sharing.

New child Checker copies source manifest/contract and evidence cache path only, then child.run(projections=False); child does not share parent hash or history memo, and run resets its independent history cache.

option_A_smallest_targeted_cache.scope: Cache fully verified legacy file-map validation within one top-level CLI invocation. No persistent file or trust across CLI calls.
option_A_smallest_targeted_cache.API_seam: Give validate_files(project,record,*,validation_cache=None) a dedicated invocation-owned file-validation memo; thread optional memo through historical_checker and HistoryView.resolve. Default uncached path preserves unrelated callers.
option_A_smallest_targeted_cache.cache_identity: Exact canonical project plus verified legacy/context record identity (or normalized full snapshot file-map/root binding), not just snapshot-root name. Member memo keyed by physical path and original expected hash plus full dev/ino/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns signature.
option_A_smallest_targeted_cache.lookup: Revalidate every logical/physical path, every ancestor no-link/escape rule, and fresh member signature; reuse only the original verified content hash for identical bound members/signatures. Membership/hash conflict or change must fail or perform safe fresh read that triggers changed-input guard; never silently reclassify mutated input as the initial snapshot.
option_A_smallest_targeted_cache.first_validation: Use existing stable hash_file streaming safeguards and retain each physical member signature for final invocation verification. Cache signatures/hashes, not8.28GB bytes.
option_A_smallest_targeted_cache.root_and_probe_lifetime: Explicit invocation-owned memo created by root run and passed to historical/progress children. Child may not reset the shared file memo; top-level completion final-checks all shared member signatures, including paths used only by children. Do not simulate sharing by setting _history_stack private sentinel; that flag also affects history recursion/cycle semantics.
option_A_smallest_targeted_cache.semantic_boundary: Keep read_ref expected-hash validation, legacy envelope classification, previous manifest legacy_format, both attempt semantic views, all unit/findings/runtime/evidence checks. This caches verified immutable IO, not successful acceptance results.

option_B_existing_history_cache_propagat.scope: Propagate root history cache to progress probe and add namespaced legacy-member validation memo inside it.
option_B_existing_history_cache_propagat.condition: Checker.run currently resets history cache when no _history_stack; add explicit invocation cache ownership rather than abusing historical-stack marker. Cached semantic context/attempt results would additionally need full dependency signature freshness/final audit before broader reuse; do not assume ref JSON alone proves dependencies unchanged.
option_B_existing_history_cache_propagat.preference: OptionA dedicated file-validation memo is narrower and leaves semantic result reuse unchanged.

planned_verification_only: Count first-read and repeat-read calls using synthetic repeated legacy maps; hashes once per unchanged physical binding and every expected hash still compared.
Mutate content, inode, parent link, file membership, expected hash or metadata signature between child probes; top-level checker remains blocked.
Keep failed attempts and legacy members byte-for-byte present and verified; no file removals/test-scope reduction.
Exercise outer+projection+nested historical invocation lifetime and ensure a later independent CLI starts fresh.
Measure actual long checker wall/CPU/peak-memory and member read/hash counts once authorized; no performance result is claimed now.
